title: A line discount is removed when marked and not restored
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, whose line 2 of 1.5 hours carries a 10% line discount.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Mark as No Charge".
  4. Pick "Goodwill" in Category.
  5. Click the confirming Mark as No Charge button.
  6. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  7. Click "Mark as Billable".
  8. Click the confirming Mark as Billable button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 2 shows its 10% discount.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Mark as No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 4:

  • Goodwill is picked.

Step 5:

  • Line 2's discount is gone.

Step 6:

  • The menu shows "Mark as Billable".

Step 7:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 8:

  • Line 2 is priced at $180.00 with no discount: it is not restored.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.4 (13 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R4: “The work order carries no badge and no header style and its classification stays billable; Financial Info (the cost view) does not change. Totals, tax, work order fees and discounts, deposits, the estimate, the portal approval and the Customer PO are computed on the billable lines; the no-charge line shows at $0.00 on the estimate and in the portal with its category under the title. A line discount on the line is removed when it is marked and not restored by Mark as Billable. A deposit on the work order does not block the mark; when, after the mark, the deposit exceeds the billable total, the dialog says "Deposit $[amount] exceeds the new total $[total]. The difference stays on the customer's account as a deposit when the invoice is created." and the existing rule applies at invoicing. An estimate already on the portal shows the live work order when the customer opens it (same link, no new email; the advisor re-sends when a fresh document is wanted), with the line at $0.00 and its category under the title and the notice "This estimate changed after it was sent. The lines above are current."; a pending IBS request is not withdrawn (ShopView has no withdrawal); as after any price change today, the advisor requests approval again with the new amount when needed. ShopView renders the estimate and invoice documents and the portal shows them; the portal renders its own approval line cards, price summary and emails, where the $0.00 line shows with its category: that portal side is its own story, SV-12296, linked to SV-12226.”
  • S12-R5: “The three-dots menu of a no-charge line offers "Change category" (the dialog of S12-R2 with the current values; Save is enabled once the category, the original work order or the original line differs) and "Mark as Billable" (confirmation "Mark line as billable?" with the body "The line is priced as a new line would be today. You can mark it No Charge again until the work order is invoiced."); confirming removes the chip and the category and prices the line as S2-R6 prices a line: labor at the customer's rate, else the location's; parts from the pricing rules on the cost already on the line. Both are unavailable once the work order is invoiced; the invoice is reversed first, as for Convert (S2-R9).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794565397-7f4c (read and rendered 14 Nov 2026: from version 1794561577-f903 one string changed, the chip of a no-charge line now reads "No Charge" on 6 boards; the other 161 boards are pixel-identical): boards "07 Invoice · the line at $0.00, Warranty" (page "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order"), "03 Line marked No Charge · $0.00" (page "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order"), "32 Line marked No Charge · $0.00" (page "Happy flow v6"). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
